steps.en: Prepare the stable release and its JDK, then launch Ghidra
steps.zh: 准备稳定版及对应 JDK，再启动 Ghidra

steps.en: Create a non-shared project and import an authorized binary
steps.zh: 新建非共享项目，导入有权分析的二进制

steps.en: Confirm processor settings and approve auto-analysis in CodeBrowser
steps.zh: 确认处理器配置，在 CodeBrowser 同意自动分析

steps.en: Disassemble flows, create functions and cross-references
steps.zh: 沿控制流反汇编，建立函数与交叉引用

steps.en: Select a function and correct its names and types
steps.zh: 选择函数，修正名字与类型

steps.en: Show linked instructions and updated C-like function text
steps.zh: 展示关联指令与更新后的类 C 函数文本

value.en: Understand a native function without rebuilding its instruction and reference map by hand
value.zh: 不必手工重建指令和引用关系，就能理解原生函数
